objective: Remove the retired research-campaign tree (curunir_operational/v3 through v5_8_1) and the tests that exercised only it, after lifting the surface the live product still depended on.

archive.note: Every removed file is reachable at this tag. Nothing in this excision is unrecoverable.

lift.reason: curunir_semantic/extract.py::extract_text_signals reached the campaign tree through two function-local imports, which a module-level scan does not see. The reachable surface was lifted before any deletion.

equivalence_evidence.method: Differential execution of the original and lifted capture() over the same corpus, comparing every field except wall-clock timestamps.
corpus_composition: every payload in the V6.8 pilot custody stores
multilingual synthetics exercising all 18 declared patterns
empty / whitespace / NUL / oversize / role-name-trap inputs

deliberate_deviations.was: module-level `assert` that no observation type names a source role
deliberate_deviations.why: `python -O` strips assert; the layer separation it guards is load-bearing.

lift.byte_contract_note: The lifted _sha256/_canonical_json/_stable_id reproduce the legacy contract, which differs from curunir_operational.canonical. They are module-private and their outputs are capture-internal: extract.py consumes only observation_type, observed_value and raw_text, so no lifted identifier or timestamp ever reaches the store. curunir_operational.canonical remains the sole owner of every persisted byte contract.

also_removed.curunir_operational/write_observation.py: 767 lines; zero live importers — imported only by the campaign tree.

split_not_deleted.tests/test_c11_capability_gaps.py: Mixed legacy and live coverage. F01 (kernel acquisition policy) and F14 (sovereignty exit test) retained; F03 prediction and the V4 security-review guard removed with the tree.

retained_despite_no_package_importer.delta.py: exercised by tests/v67/test_store_integrity.py and the V2 suites
retained_despite_no_package_importer.partition_custody.py: exercised by its own test and tools/validate_v67.py
retained_despite_no_package_importer.stress.py: exercised by test_operational_v2_fabric and the surface audit
retained_despite_no_package_importer.providers_eval.py: no current caller, but it is the harness that evaluates an analytical provider; retained for the model-provider work

node_set_effect.method: Full pytest run with junitxml before and after, in one environment, comparing every node id and its outcome kind.
node_set_effect.interpretation: Every surviving node kept its exact outcome. The collection count drop is declared here and is the excision itself, not a regression or an increase in skipping.

residual_nonpassing_after.composition: Pre-existing ARGUS neural/extractor/capsule residuals that need untracked corpora, plus the V6.8 harness tests, which refuse a dirty checkout by design and pass from a clean one.
